newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net Upland sales of 53,600 running bales (RB) were 54 percent below the previous week and 58 percent below the 4-week average. Major increases for South Korea (26,400 RB), Canada (14,800 RB), and China (13,700 RB) were partially offset by reductions for Pakistan (13,900 RB) and unknown destinations (11,000 RB).
Exports of 128,900 RB exceeded the previous week's marketing-year high by one-fifth and the 4-week average by 38 percent.
Asian destinations accounted for 66 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 25 percent; African, 4 percent; East European, 3 percent; and West European, 2 percent.
